head: HEAD
message:
yeet publish refuses a stale base: files changed on this branch were also changed on origin/main since the merge-base, so the PR would conflict or silently regress them.
3 path(s) across 3 top-level entries: bun.lock, package.json, packages
  - bun.lock
  - package.json
  - packages/tooling/tool/cli/test/sync-data-to-ts.test.ts
Remedy: git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main, re-run bun run beep yeet verify, then publish again. Pass --allow-stale-base to proceed anyway.
